answers.explanation: Establish (register, invite, answer, ack), communicate (media), terminate (BYE).
200 OK means the call is answered.
The three-way handshake of SIP: INVITE, 200 OK, ACK.
SIP sets the session up. RTP carries the media.
A 4xx reply: the request can't be completed.
Ending the session so both sides can free resources.
